title: Snell's Law of Refraction via Fermat's Principle
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A light ray travels from point A(0, a) in medium 1 (speed v1) to point B(d, -b) in medium 2 (speed v2), crossing the interface at (x, 0). Show that minimizing travel time yields Snell's Law: sin(theta1)/v1 = sin(theta2)/v2.

steps.title: Express Total Travel Time T(x)
steps.explanation: Travel time equals distance divided by speed for each medium.

steps.title: Differentiate with Respect to Crossing Coordinate x
steps.explanation: Apply chain rule to both radical terms.

steps.title: Identify Trigonometric Sines of Angles
steps.explanation: Substitute geometric sines of angles with the surface normal.
